meta.title: LoRA panel
meta.description: Adds a read-only LoRA panel to the left sidebar. Opening its entry re-reads D:\CreativeModels\lora_meta.json and lists every LoRA as a card grouped by base_group (MOSS, Anima, Illustrious / SDXL, Pony): the Civitai title with its bracket suffix kept verbatim, then version, alias, file name, kind, trigger words and default weight. Clicking a card copies "file:weight"; an entry whose default_weight is null shows "Weight missing" and copies nothing. A card whose loader is LoraLoader is marked as needing CLIP in the chain as well. The panel writes no file and reads no other path; disabling the plugin removes the sidebar entry and its page.
